name: Del Haskins
bio: A long-haul trucker who has stopped at Kessler Flats for twenty years. Talks too much. Means well.

name: Priya
bio: A college student driving home for the weekend. Her reflection has other plans.

name: Nurse Okafor
bio: A night-shift nurse at Kessler County General. She has seen the things that come in after 3 AM.

name: Man in the Orange Vest
bio: A local who walks the road at night. He has heard the knocking too.

name: Girl with a Leash
bio: She walks her dog every night. The dog only shows up on camera.

name: The Drenched Man
bio: Walter Pruitt drove the 2:58 AM Coach 313 from Kessler Flats. He is always soaked and always thirsty.

name: The Smiling Woman
bio: She introduces herself as Mrs. Marsh. She is looking for her daughter. Her smile grows every time you see her.

name: The Passenger
bio: Ellis Crane, an insurance salesman with a ticket for a bus that never comes.

name: The Collector
bio: A tall man in a pinstriped coat who keeps a ledger. Polite. Patient. Interested in what the machine makes.

name: The Silent Child
bio: A small girl in a yellow raincoat who never speaks. She talks by pressing things against the glass.

name: The Former Employee
bio: Mara Quill worked this booth before you. Her badge number was 0412. Now it reads No. 0.

name: Officer Brandt
bio: Kessler County highway patrol. Tired, kind, and looking for a missing trucker.

name: Mr. Hale
bio: Your supervisor at the Meridian District Office. You have only ever heard his voice — until tonight.

name: Something Wearing a Face
bio: It learns faces from the people who come back. It is very good at it. It is not good at reflections.

name: The Attendant
bio: It wears a Meridian uniform. It wears your posture. You never quite see its face.

name: Stranded Motorist
bio: A man whose car broke down on Route 9 at exactly the wrong time.

name: Night Runner
bio: Runs Route 9 at midnight because it's the only time it's quiet.

name: The Thirteen
bio: Thirteen people from Coach 313, standing at the edge of the lot in the rain.
